Beat.description: One idea on screen for a few seconds.

continuity.description: Whether a subject of this beat stays on screen into the next beat. Defaults to "none".

energy.description: Pace and intensity of the beat. Defaults to "building".

keyword.description:
Optional single word shown very large and faint in the background.
Defaults to the primary subject's meaning (or its value).

narration.description: Optional voice-over line for this beat: what the narrator SAYS, written the way you would say it out loud to a friend (1–2 natural sentences, about 8–30 words; contractions, questions and asides are welcome). All beats' lines are read in ONE take by one voice, so write them as one continuous script: each line continues the previous one and never restarts the topic or re-introduces the subject. The on-screen `statement` stays a short title. Omit it and the narrator reads the statement.

primary.description: The main subject of the beat.

relationship.description: How primary and secondary relate. Meaningful for "compare" and "contrast" beats.

secondary.description: An optional second subject (the other side of a comparison, a supporting phrase or object).

statement.description: The one sentence this beat communicates, as the viewer should read it. Keep it short (about 3–8 words).

CollectionItem.description: One item of a collection. Items cannot themselves be collections.

oneOf.description: A named item, e.g. "Coffee".

meaning.description:
What the subject stands for, in 1–3 words (e.g. "passengers"). Shown as a small label and
used as the default background keyword. Shown instead of `value` when `value` is missing.

value.description:
Text shown for the subject exactly as written: the phrase, or the number with its
unit/symbol (e.g. "120", "+40%", "3.5 km").

oneOf.description: An item that is a figure, e.g. "₹120" with meaning "coffee".

meaning.description:
What the subject stands for, in 1–3 words (e.g. "passengers"). Shown as a small label and
used as the default background keyword. Shown instead of `value` when `value` is missing.

value.description:
Text shown for the subject exactly as written: the phrase, or the number with its
unit/symbol (e.g. "120", "+40%", "3.5 km").

oneOf.description: A pictured item from the built-in asset library.

asset.description: The pictured thing as a short lowercase snake_case noun, e.g. "piggy_bank", "alarm_clock", "coffee_cup". The engine finds a matching picture in its library; if none exists the object is shown as text (its meaning), so any concrete noun is safe.

meaning.description: What the object stands for, in 1–3 words.

value.description: A short figure stamped next to the object in compare/contrast beats (e.g. "₹6,900").

Continuity.description: Whether a subject of this beat stays on screen into the next beat.

oneOf.description: Nothing carries over. The default.
The primary subject stays on screen and travels into the next beat.
The secondary subject stays on screen and travels into the next beat.
Unhurried, gentle, reflective.
Steady editorial momentum. The default.

Punchy and fast. A "reveal" beat with impact energy that follows another beat arrives with a bold
full-screen accent-color transition.
9:16 portrait (1080 x 1920) for shorts / reels. The primary, best-supported format.

boundary.description:
True for a thin boundary between two layers (e.g. a thermocline) rather than a layer
of its own. A boundary sits between two ordinary layers. Defaults to false.

name.description: The layer's name, in 1–4 words (e.g. "Photic zone"). Names must differ within a stack.

note.description: A short note shown under the name, up to about 6 words (e.g. "sunlit, photosynthesis").

MetricFormat.description: How a derived value is written.

oneOf.description: As a percentage, e.g. 80 ÷ 1000 → "8%". The default.
As a plain decimal, e.g. 1 ÷ 8 → "0.125".

NumericTerm.description: A plain number with what it counts.

value.description: The number itself, as a JSON number (e.g. 1000, not "1,000").

Operation.description: How a derived value is calculated.

oneOf.description: numerator ÷ denominator.
Make one idea land: a bold headline plus a hero subject.
Put two subjects side by side neutrally. Default relationship: "separate".
Put two subjects in tension. Default relationship: "compress".
Deliver a payoff or conclusion: the primary (usually a number) is unveiled as the answer.
Explain something: the primary becomes the headline and the statement is read as body text.

Relationship.description: How the primary and secondary subjects relate (used by compare / contrast beats).

oneOf.description: The secondary gains weight or size over the beat.
The secondary creates pressure: the space and presence of the primary shrink while the secondary looms larger.
The two subjects pull apart, with a visible divide between them.
The secondary takes over from the primary, which recedes.
The primary persists steadily; also keeps the primary on screen into the next beat (like continuity "carry_primary").
Separate items add up, one after another, into one larger consequence. Best with a "collection" primary.

Subject.description: A thing the beat is about. `kind` decides which other fields apply.

oneOf.description: Words: a name, a claim, a short phrase.

meaning.description:
What the subject stands for, in 1–3 words (e.g. "passengers"). Shown as a small label and
used as the default background keyword. Shown instead of `value` when `value` is missing.

value.description:
Text shown for the subject exactly as written: the phrase, or the number with its
unit/symbol (e.g. "120", "+40%", "3.5 km").

oneOf.description: A figure: count, amount, percentage, measurement.

meaning.description:
What the subject stands for, in 1–3 words (e.g. "passengers"). Shown as a small label and
used as the default background keyword. Shown instead of `value` when `value` is missing.

value.description:
Text shown for the subject exactly as written: the phrase, or the number with its
unit/symbol (e.g. "120", "+40%", "3.5 km").

oneOf.description: A pictured thing from the built-in asset library.

asset.description: The pictured thing as a short lowercase snake_case noun, e.g. "piggy_bank", "alarm_clock", "coffee_cup". The engine finds a matching picture in its library; if none exists the object is shown as text (its meaning), so any concrete noun is safe.

meaning.description: What the object stands for, in 1–3 words.

value.description: A short figure stamped next to the object in compare/contrast beats (e.g. "₹6,900").

oneOf.description: Several distinct items that belong together (2–6), e.g. the things that add up to a total.

items.description: The items, in the order they should appear. 2 to 6 items; each is a phrase, number or object.

meaning.description: What the items are together, in 1–3 words (e.g. "drinks"). Used to name the total.

oneOf.description: One thing moving from one state to another, e.g. delivery time: "three days" → "same day".

entity.description: What is changing, in 1–3 words (e.g. "delivery time").

from.description: The state before, in 1–4 words (e.g. "three days").

meaning.description: What the change means, in 1–4 words (e.g. "faster").

to.description: The state after, in 1–4 words (e.g. "same day").

oneOf.description: A value MotionEngine calculates from two numbers (a ratio), e.g. 80 sign-ups out of 1000 visitors.

denominator.description: The whole it is measured against (e.g. 1000 visitors). Must not be 0.

format.description: How the result is written. Defaults to "percent".

meaning.description: Name of the calculated value, in 1–3 words (e.g. "sign-up rate").

operation.description: How the value is derived. Only "ratio" (numerator ÷ denominator) exists. Defaults to "ratio".

oneOf.description: Things that are layered or stacked, named in order from the top (or start) down, e.g. the zones of the ocean. Use it as the primary of every beat that is about the same layers, repeating the same list: the layers then stay on screen from beat to beat and the viewer sees where each beat is happening.

focus.description: The `name` of the layer this beat is about. Omit it for a beat about the whole stack.

layers.description:
The layers from top to bottom (or first to last). 2 to 6; the first and the last must
be ordinary layers, not boundaries.

meaning.description: What the layers make up together, in 1–3 words (e.g. "ocean water column").

description:
A short motion-graphics story: a title, an output format and 1+ beats.
Describes WHAT to communicate; MotionEngine decides layout, animation and rendering.

beats.description: The story, in order. One beat = one idea. At least one beat is required.

title.description:
Short name of the piece. Also used as the render output folder and video
file name, so prefer letters, digits, '_' and '-'.

version.description:
Contract version. Must be exactly "0.2" for this contract
(documents written for the legacy "0.1" contract are still accepted).
